scope: Manually reviewed primary-source signals connected to ClearTrial portfolio assets

signals.headline: K36 reported FDA clearance of the KTX-1001 IND
signals.summary: The sponsor said its lead MMSET inhibitor could proceed into a Phase 1 study.

source.title: K36 Therapeutics Announces FDA Clearance of Investigational New Drug Application for KTX-1001
source.quote: FDA has cleared its Investigational New Drug (IND) Application for the Company's lead program KTX-1001.

signals.reviewNote: ClinicalTrials.gov corroborates the later Phase 1 program, not FDA's IND action itself.

signals.headline: K36 reported the first patient dosed in NCT05651932
signals.summary: The company linked the dosing milestone to the registered KTX-MMSET-001 study.

source.title: K36 Therapeutics Announces Dosing of First Patient in KTX-1001 Phase 1 Clinical Trial
source.quote: the first patient has been dosed in its Phase 1 clinical trial earlier this year.

signals.reviewNote: The registry confirms the study identity and status; dosing remains a sponsor-reported event.

signals.indication: Acute myeloid leukemia or high-risk myelodysplastic syndrome
signals.headline: Orum reported FDA clearance before BMS acquired ORM-6151
signals.summary: The release connects a regulatory milestone, an asset transaction, and the later BMS-986497 program.

source.title: Orum Therapeutics Announces Acquisition of ORM-6151 Program by Bristol Myers Squibb
source.quote: ORM-6151 ... has received the FDA's clearance for Phase 1.

reasons: ORM-6151 alias appears in registry title

signals.reviewNote: The registry establishes the later BMS-986497 study; it does not independently confirm the clearance claim.

signals.headline: Partners announced interim ROSETTA Lung-02 data
signals.summary: The announcement names the exact recruiting trial and notes its Phase 3 portion.

source.title: Global Data for Pumitamig in ROSETTA Lung-02
source.quote: interim Phase 2 data from the global Phase 2/3 ROSETTA Lung-02 clinical trial (NCT06712316)

signals.reviewNote: The registry corroborates study identity and recruiting status, not the sponsor-reported efficacy results.
